photos.c: "Right, who's next" - Some of the Belgrave lads stand prepared to take on all-comers. Left to right: Gary Budinger, S.Watts, Mark Shippen, Robert Bashford, Steve Walters, Gary Wallace, David Didino and Ivan Beaumont.
Front Page: David Bailey strides out to win the Senior Boys 100m at the Club Championships and shows fine style in the process. Ivan Beaumont was second and Mark Shippen third.
Front page: Mark Shippen shoots for 4.20m in the Southern League pole vault at Battersea.
Mark Shippen winner of the Club P.V.Championship has shown a welcome return to form this year

BACK COVER. After several years of consolidation Mark Shippen has shown a welcome improvement in his vaulting. Not only has he increased his personal best to 4.40m but he has shown greater confidence under pressure. Mark has been a consistant and prolific points scorer in our British League matches and he and Phil Lovell form a very formidable partnership for next season.
